full_prompt_en: A square storybook illustration shows an oversized green frog traveler on a golden hill above a small old village. The frog stands at the left with wide round eyes and a gently uncertain mouth. A tan shirt, rust-brown trousers and a packed basket on its back turn the creature into a humorous wanderer, while its large textured feet press into the dry grass. Slightly to its right, a much smaller traveler with a walking stick faces the village, providing a clear contrast in scale. Below them, clustered stone buildings with red-tiled roofs step down toward a blue-green strip of water. A narrow church tower rises on the right, its pointed roof reaching into the pale cloud band. In the distance, muted lavender hills run across the horizon beneath a desaturated blue sky. A small orange hot-air balloon floats near the upper center, suspended between large warm-white clouds. The image is enclosed by a thin aged-paper border, and its entire surface has fine stippling, short hatch marks and muted grain. Outlines are dark brown rather than jet black, with warm ochre, moss green, brick red and dusty blue colors layered like old printed pigments. Light is soft and even, though a warm glow brightens the hill and the clouds; shadows remain shallow and gently hatched. No readable text appears. The overall composition feels quaint and adventurous, balancing a large fantastical figure with the detailed miniature settlement and open balloon-filled sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形童话书插画呈现一只巨大的绿色青蛙旅人站在小型古老村庄上方的金色山坡上。青蛙位于左侧，双眼又圆又大，嘴角带一点不确定。浅棕衬衫、锈棕长裤和背后的满载篮筐把它变成诙谐的漫游者，宽大有纹理的脚踩在干草上。它右边稍远处，一名小得多、拄手杖的旅人面向村庄，形成明确尺度对比。下方，红瓦屋顶的石砌房屋成簇沿坡走向一道蓝绿色水面。右边一座狭窄教堂塔楼升起，尖屋顶进入浅色云带。远处，低调淡紫色山丘横过地平线，其上是降饱和蓝色天空。一只小橘色热气球漂在上部中央，悬在大片暖白云之间。画面由细旧纸边框围住，整个表面带细密点描、短排线与低调颗粒。轮廓是深棕而非纯黑，暖赭、苔绿、砖红与灰蓝像旧印刷颜料一样层叠。光线柔和均匀，但一抹暖光照亮山坡和云朵；阴影浅而由轻柔排线塑成。没有可读文字。整体构图古雅而有冒险气息，用巨大的幻想形体平衡细密微型聚落与热气球所在的开阔天空。
style_prompt_en: A vintage storybook-illustration treatment combines intricate brown ink outlines, close stippling and short hatch marks with softly layered printed color. Warm ochre, moss green, brick red and dusty blue dominate, all slightly faded as though absorbed by old paper. Larger rounded forms carry clear silhouettes, while distant areas shrink into many miniature marks and muted tonal layers. Edges are defined but gently worn; a faint border and pervasive grain give the image the character of an aged book page. Illumination is diffuse and warm, with shallow shadows created more by hatched texture than by strong modeling. A dense lower section opens into a quieter pale upper field, and playful scale contrasts add a quietly whimsical rhythm without breaking the careful craft.
style_prompt_zh: 复古童话书插画处理把精细棕色墨线轮廓、密集点描与短排线同柔和层叠的印刷色结合。暖赭、苔绿、砖红与灰蓝占主导，整体略褪色，仿佛吸入旧纸。较大圆润形体保持清楚剪影，远处区域则缩为许多微小笔痕与低调色层。边缘明确却轻微磨旧；隐约边框和遍布的颗粒让画面带有老书页气质。光线漫射且偏暖，浅阴影更多由排线肌理而非强烈塑形建立。密集的下部向更安静的浅色上部敞开，俏皮尺度对比带来静静的奇想节奏，却不破坏谨慎的手工质感。
theme_en: A green frog traveler above an old village beneath a small hot-air balloon
theme_zh: 小热气球下，一只绿色青蛙旅人站在古老村庄上方
name: Dave Coverly
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
